summary: Entergy Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the physical settlement of its 2025 underwritten forward sale agreements. On September 2, 2026, the company delivered 11,145,984 shares of common stock to counterparties, receiving approximately $913 million in cash proceeds. This settlement relates to a portion of the 17,796,401 shares originally covered by the March 17, 2025 agreements. After settlement, no obligations remain under the 2025 agreements. The company separately has forward sale agreements outstanding from a May 5, 2026 offering of $2.175 billion covering 19,247,788 shares. This is a routine equity financing transaction, not a special situation; it merely reports the finalization of previously disclosed forward sales.
